summary.environment: Local XAMPP (Apache, PHP 8.0, MariaDB 10.4) + Vite dev server, Chromium (Playwright) at 390×844 phone and 1440×900 desktop sizes
summary.fareShown: Fixed fare Cash Base fare (includes 1 km) ₱30 Total ₱30

results.steps: Open Sign in, enter a registered phone number and password, tap Log In.
results.expected: The user is signed in and taken to the passenger Home screen.
results.actual: Signed in and the passenger Home screen with the map and “Where to?” panel opened.

results.steps: Enter a registered phone number with a wrong password, tap Log In.
results.expected: Access is refused with an error message; the user stays on Sign in.
results.actual: Access refused with “We couldn’t sign you in with those details”; stayed on Sign in.

results.steps: Open Sign up, choose Passenger, fill in name, phone, town and password, tap Create account.
results.expected: A passenger account is created with the chosen town and the user is signed in.
results.actual: Account created (phone saved as +639990000601, town Carrascal) and signed in to Home.

results.steps: Open Sign up, choose Driver, fill in details, plate, body number, TODA, license number, upload a license photo, tap Create account.
results.expected: A driver account is created as “pending” with the license photo saved for admin review.
results.actual: Driver account created as pending; Profile shows the license photo is waiting for admin review.

results.feature: Admin reviews license and approves driver
results.steps: Sign in as admin, open Dashboard → Drivers, tap Review ID on the new driver, compare the photo with the details, tap Approve.
results.expected: The license photo and details are shown; the driver becomes Verified and is notified.
results.actual: License photo and details shown side by side; after Approve the driver shows “Verified” and received “You’re approved”.

results.steps: Sign in as an approved driver, open Requests, switch to online.
results.expected: The driver is shown as online and ready to receive nearby ride requests.
results.actual: Driver shown as “You’re online” with requests listed below; location shared with the server.

results.steps: On Home, tap the pickup field and the map, then the destination field and the map; review the fare; tap Find a Tricycle.
results.expected: A fixed fare with breakdown is shown before booking; the request is sent and “Finding a tricycle” appears.
results.actual: Fare shown before booking (₱30); request sent and “Finding a tricycle” shown.

results.feature: Nearest driver receives and accepts the request
results.steps: As the online driver nearby, wait for the request card, tap Accept.
results.expected: The request appears for the nearest driver with pickup, destination and fare; after Accept both sides see the ride details.
results.actual: Request card showed pickup, destination and fare; after Accept the driver got the trip screen and the passenger saw the driver details (ride #44).

results.steps: Watch the ride screen after the driver starts the pickup.
results.expected: The map shows the driver’s position and a route that follows the streets, with ETA and distance.
results.actual: Driver marker and route shown; route has 4 points (follows streets), ETA 1 min, 0.16 km.

results.feature: Share live trip with a contact
results.steps: During the ride, create a trip link and open it in a browser without signing in.
results.expected: The shared page shows the trip status and driver without needing an account.
results.actual: Trip link created; without signing in, the public page showed “Live trip”, the driver and plate, and a 464px map with the driver’s position.

results.steps: Tap Start trip, then Complete ride.
results.expected: The ride is marked completed with the final fare and the driver returns to Requests.
results.actual: Ride marked completed with final fare ₱30; driver taken to their Rides list, which shows the completed trip.

results.steps: When the ride completes, choose a star rating, add a comment and tap Submit review.
results.expected: The rating is saved and shown in the driver’s rating.
results.actual: Review submitted; driver rating now 5.0.

results.steps: Open the Alerts tab after the ride.
results.expected: The passenger sees Driver found, Driver on the way, Trip started and Trip completed.
results.actual: All four ride notices shown: Driver found, Driver on the way, Trip started, Trip completed (with fare).

results.steps: Open the Rides tab and filter by Completed.
results.expected: The completed ride appears with date, places, status and fare.
results.actual: Completed ride listed with date, pickup, destination, “Completed” status and fare.

results.steps: Book another ride, then tap Cancel booking while finding a tricycle.
results.expected: The request is cancelled and the passenger returns to Home.
results.actual: Booking cancelled from “Finding a tricycle”; ride saved as cancelled and Home shown again.

results.steps: Tap the pickup field, then tap a spot on the map.
results.expected: The pickup field shows a street or place name instead of only coordinates.
results.actual: Pickup field shows “Embarcadero, Carrascal”.

results.steps: Passenger taps Emergency SOS → Confirm SOS; admin opens Dashboard → SOS and taps Mark resolved.
results.expected: The alert reaches the admins with the passenger’s details and location, and can be resolved.
results.actual: SOS sent with location; admin saw the passenger’s name, town (Carrascal), phone, time and “Open reported location”, and marked it resolved.

results.steps: Admin opens Dashboard → Alerts, targets Carrascal, writes a title and message, taps Publish alert; passenger in Carrascal opens Alerts.
results.expected: The alert is published and appears in the Carrascal passenger’s Alerts.
results.actual: Alert published to Carrascal and shown at the top of the Carrascal passenger’s Alerts.

results.steps: Open Dashboard → Fares, raise the Carrascal base fare, tap Save; get a new fare estimate for the same trip.
results.expected: The change is saved and new estimates use it.
results.actual: Saved; the same trip’s estimate went from ₱30 to ₱40 (base fare ₱30 → ₱40). Restored after testing.

results.steps: On the Dashboard, tap PDF, then Excel.
results.expected: Both files download and contain the summary and ride list.
results.actual: pasakja-report PDF and Excel files downloaded (saved as evidence).

results.steps: On Sign in tap Forgot password? and send a request; admin taps Issue temporary password; user signs in with it and sets a new password in Profile.
results.expected: The request reaches the admin; the temporary password works once and the user can set a new one.
results.actual: Request reached the admin; temporary password issued and accepted; new password set and working.

results.steps: Open Profile, tap Add a photo and choose an image.
results.expected: The photo is saved and shown on the profile, also after reopening the app.
results.actual: Photo saved and still shown after reloading the app.

results.steps: As a passenger, open an admin address and call admin functions.
results.expected: The passenger cannot open admin screens or use admin functions.
results.actual: Admin address sent the passenger back to /passenger/home; admin functions answered 403 Forbidden (4 of 4).

results.feature: Fits phone, tablet and desktop screens
results.steps: Open the passenger Home on an iPhone-sized screen, a tablet and a desktop.
results.expected: All content fits the screen without sideways scrolling; the map stays visible.
results.actual: iphone12 390px: no sideways scroll, map 252px tall; tablet 768px: no sideways scroll, map 458px tall; desktop 1440px: no sideways scroll, map 389px tall.

results.feature: Admin suspends and reactivates an account
results.steps: Admin opens Dashboard → Accounts, finds the passenger, taps Suspend, gives a reason and confirms; the passenger tries to sign in; admin taps Reactivate.
results.expected: The account is marked Suspended and signed out; the passenger is refused sign-in and sees the reason; after Reactivate they can sign in again.
results.actual: Account marked “Suspended” with the reason and signed out of its open session; sign-in refused with “This account is suspended: UAT check of account suspension.”; after Reactivate the passenger signed in again.

results.steps: As the driver who completed the UAT ride, open Profile and look at Earnings.
results.expected: Earnings for today, this week, this month and all time are shown, match the driver’s completed rides, and today includes the UAT ride’s fare.
results.actual: Earnings shown — today ₱30 · 1 ride, this week ₱30 · 1 ride, this month ₱145 · 5 rides, all time ₱145 · 5 rides; today includes the UAT ride (₱30).

results.feature: Edit profile and change phone number
results.steps: Open Profile, tap Edit, change the phone number, enter the current password, tap Save changes; sign in with the new number.
results.expected: The new number is saved and works for signing in; the old number no longer does.
results.actual: Phone changed after entering the current password; “Profile saved. Sign in with +639990000611 from now on.” shown; the new number signs in and the old one is refused.

results.steps: Passenger books a ride; the online driver taps Decline on the request card.
results.expected: The request leaves that driver’s list and the booking stays open for another driver instead of being assigned to them.
results.actual: After Decline the request left the driver’s list; ride #46 stayed “finding” (not assigned to that driver), then the passenger cancelled it.
